instruction.name: fldle.d
instruction.description: Floating-point bound-checked load, condition rj <= rk.

experiments.command: ./bench --method slope --unroll 800 --unroll2 1600 --iters 40 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --init 'addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; li.d $r22, -64; and $r20, $r20, $r22; li.d $r4, 8; st.d $r4, $r20, 0; li.d $r4, 0; st.d $r4, $r20, 8; li.d $r5, 9223372036854775807; addi.d $r4, $r20, 0' --asm 'fldle.d $f0, $r4, $r5; movfr2gr.d $r4, $f0; add.d $r4, $r4, $r20'
experiments.name: base operand path

latencies.notes: 5 cycles from the base operand rj to the destination. The loop closes through movfr2gr (2 cycles) and, because the loaded value has to be turned back into an address, through an add.d (1 cycle); the chain also carries one further cycle that the address generator pays whenever the address comes from an ALU operation rather than straight from the register file, so 4 cycles are subtracted. The load itself is 5, the same as fld.d/fld.s and one cycle above the integer loads.

experiments.command: ./bench --method slope --unroll 800 --unroll2 1600 --iters 40 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --init 'addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; li.d $r22, -64; and $r20, $r20, $r22; li.d $r4, 8; st.d $r4, $r20, 0; li.d $r4, 0; st.d $r4, $r20, 8; addi.d $r4, $r20, 0' --asm 'fldle.d $f0, $r20, $r4; movfr2gr.d $r4, $f0; add.d $r4, $r4, $r20'
experiments.name: bound operand path

latencies.notes: 5 cycles from the index or bound operand rk to the destination. Where the loaded value can feed the address or the range check directly the chain is just the load plus movfr2gr (2 cycles); when an andi or add.d is in the path the chain carries one more cycle than that helper, which is the ALU-address premium rather than load latency.

throughput.notes: 8 independent lanes: 7.98 core cycles per 8 instructions, CPI 1. Slope method (--unroll 1000, --unroll2 2000).

notes: 5 cycles, the same for single and double precision and for both the base and the index or bound operand. The value cannot become an address directly, so the measurement chain always contains movfr2gr (2 cycles), and chains that need an add.d, an andi or an fadd.d as well read one cycle more than those helpers; that cycle is the address-generator premium, not load latency.
